name: dsh-search-web-perplexity
description: Local DSH profile plugin: Perplexity Search API (POST /search, model-agnostic) provider for the web capability seam (ctx.web), plus its web settings card. Host half registers provider id 'dsh-search-web-perplexity' and the 'dsh-search-web-perplexity' settings namespace; browser half registers a card into settings.plugin.item.
